newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Investcorp refuses comment on Welcome Break.
newsitem.headline: Investcorp refuses comment on Welcome Break.

text.p: International investment bank Investcorp on Tuesday declined to comment on reports it was emerging as the frontrunner to buy Britain's Granada Group Plc motorway service-stations chain Welcome Break.
"We have no comment on the speculation," an Investcorp official told Reuters when asked to comment on the report.

Britain's Sunday Times newspaper said Investcorp had been selected as the preferred bidder in the auction and has offered between 400 and 450 million stg for Welcome Break, topping a 400 million stg bid from supermarket chain Asda Group.

Bahrain-based Investcorp, an international investment bank, specialises in investing private Arab funds in the United States and European markets. It posted a record $90.4 million net profit in 1996, up from $70.3 million the previous year.
